cuts._format: single_tangent/inflection_*: [x1,y1,x2,y2] (ray from the tangent/reflex vertex P1 to the boundary hit P2); general_inflection_cut: [[x1,y1,x2,y2], fromLine, counterClockWise]; bitangent_cut: [[cut], thisPoint, oppositePoint, [oppositeSegment], [curveToPoint]]

point_in_polygon.lattice: x,y in 50,100,...,950; rows by y ascending, chars by x ascending

visibility_format: physical_gaps: [startEdge, endEdge, startPoint|null, endPoint|null] in Java output order; seg_in_polygon_to_vertices: char j = segInPolygon(q -> v_j); visibility_polygon (every few points only): getVisibilityPolygon vertex list incl. duplicates
